columns.name: position
columns.dc:description: Vote position. One of `FOR`, `AGAINST`, `ABSTENTION` if the MEP participated in the vote or `DID_NOT_VOTE` if the MEP wasn’t present for the vote. We currently do not differentiate between MEPs who did not vote with or without an excuse.

columns.name: group_code
columns.dc:description: Group code. This references the political group that the MEP was part of on the day of the vote. This is not necessarily the MEP’s current political group.

columns.name: group_short_label
columns.dc:description: Short label of the political group that the MEP was part of on the day of the vote. This is not necessarily the MEP’s current political group.

columns.name: national_party_id
columns.dc:description: National party ID. This references the national party that the MEP was part of on the day of the vote. This is not necessarily the MEP’s current national party.

columns.name: national_party_short_label
columns.dc:description: Short label of the national party that the MEP was part of on the day of the vote. This is not necessarily the MEP's current national party.
